description: Offre de transports du réseau Le BUS de la Communauté de Communes du Bassin de Pont-à-Mousson (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Le BUS (CC B PAM). List of CC B PAM transport network schedules and stops in GTFS format, for regular and on-demand routes. (2 separate files). Coverage: Le BUS (CC B PAM). The portal shows the English title as "Transport offer of the network The BUS of the Community of Communes of the Bassin de Pont-à-Mousson (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Le BUS (CC B PAM). Its keywords include gtfs, arrets, horaires, pont-a-mousson, bus, transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2018-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
